source: 大考中心高中英文參考詞彙表：舊版六級與111學年度起適用新版之聯集

entries.zh: 第一個字母 A; 一個; 第一的\r；rt. [計] 累加器, 加法器, 地址, 振幅, 模擬, 區域, 面積, 彙編, 元件, 非同步
example: It might sound far-fetched, but this is a real problem.
這可能聽起來牽強，但卻是個真實的問題。
The library opens at 9 a.m. every weekday.
圖書館在每個平日上午九點開門。

entries.zh: 在四周；在附近；大約；大約；關於
example: What do you think about having breakfast at McDonald's?
你覺得在麥當勞吃早餐如何？

entries.zh: 上文的,前述的；在上面；在上文；更高；在…之上
example: It goes without saying that health is above wealth.
健康勝過財富，這件事誰都知道。
According to the forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
根據天氣預報，明天會下雨。

entries.zh: 以後,之後；在後面,隨後；在…之後；在...之後
example: After I talked with my teacher, I decided to work hard.
跟我的老師談過後，我決定認真努力。
I will have read Hamlet three times if I read it again.
我再看一次《王子復仇記》，加起來一共就看過三次了。
I found a good place to buy fruit a couple of days ago.
前幾天我發現了一個買水果的好地方。
I'm sending you a birthday present by airmail.
我寄給你一個航空郵件生日禮物。

entries.zh: 所有的；全部；完全地；(比分等)雙方相等；全體,一切；全部財產
example: Everyone opposed it, but they got married all the same.
他們不理眾人的反對結了婚。

entries.zh: 向前；一起；帶著；來到；去到；沿著
example: She probably can get along well with her mother-in-law.
她應該能跟我奶奶相處得來。
It is true that television also has some disadvantages.
電視的確有一些缺點。

entries.zh: 是,在；be動詞第一人稱,單數,現在式
example: If you are not going to the concert, then neither am I.
如果你不去音樂會, 我也不去。
Having a driver's license is an advantage for this job.
有駕照者優先得到這個職位。
Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.
蔬果對平衡飲食必不可少。
Today, I made another friend who could speak Esperanto.
今天又結交了一個說世界語的朋友。

entries.zh: 任何的；(用於疑問句,否定句,if子句中)少許,稍微
example: The one resource more precious than any other was land.
唯一比無論什麼資源都珍貴的是土地。
If anybody is still absent, please send their names to me.
如果仍然有人缺席的，請將名單發給我。
Tom is better at science than anyone else in his class.
湯姆的科學成績比班上的任何一個人都要好。
I've never seen you cook. Can you cook anything at all?
我從來沒看見過你做飯.有你會做的東西嗎?
You should turn in your term papers by the end of April.
請在四月底之前交上你的學期報告。

entries.zh: 是,在；be動詞第一、第三人稱,複數,現在式；第二次人單、複數,現在式
example: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.
蔬果對平衡飲食必不可少。

entries.zh: 到處,四處；周圍,附近；環繞；大約；差不多；環繞
example: I want to go on a journey around the world if possible.
如果可能的話我想去世界各地旅行。

entries.zh: 跟...一樣地,同樣地；如同；例如；以…的身份；作為；依照；當...時
example: Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
別忘了一到倫敦就給我們留言啊。
My brother is very important. At least he thinks he is.
我弟弟非常重要。至少他認為他是。
She told me that she would go to Paris in August.
她跟我說八月份她會去巴黎。

entries.zh: (aunt的暱稱)伯母；嬸母；姑母；姨母；舅母
example: Auntie, we’ve come to wish you a Happy New Year.
大媽, 我們給您拜年來啦！

entries.zh: (aunt的暱稱)伯母；嬸母；姑母；姨母；舅母
example: Aunty Kelly treated us to ice cream today.
In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
有些動物會在秋天為冬季儲藏食物。
In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
有些動物會在秋天為冬季儲藏食物。

entries.zh: 後面的；拖欠的；過去的；向後；追溯；回覆；贊助；回原處；背部；後面
example: Next time you come, don't forget to give it back to me.
你下次來的時候，別忘了把它還給我。
Due to bad weather, the plane arrived three hours late.
由於天氣不好，飛機遲到了3小時。
My mother happened to be there when the fire broke out.
著火的時候我媽媽恰好在那。
He was absent from school yesterday because he was ill.
他昨天沒來上學，因為他病了。
He worked day and night so that he might become rich.
他想成為有錢人，所以便從早到晚不斷地工作。

entries.zh: 較早；以前；曾經；在前；向前；在…之前；在...以前；與其...寧可；否則,要不然
example: I always have a look at the newspaper before breakfast.
我經常在早飯前看一眼報紙。

entries.zh: 在背後；向背後；遲；落後；在…後面
example: The police will put you behind bars for twenty years.
警方會把你關在牢裡二十年。
The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
零度以下的氣溫持續了好幾天。
Jessie strolled along beside the cart.
傑西推著手推車散步。

entries.zh: 最好的；最熟練的；最適當的；打敗；勝過；最好地；最適當地；最；極；最好；最佳；最好
example: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
我們應該盡力不要汙染環境。

entries.zh: 在中間；介乎兩者之間；在…和…之間
example: The comparison between the two was to his disadvantage.
兩相比較，他那邊的形勢更不利一些。
Every day I either ride a bike or get the bus to work.
我每天要麼騎腳踏車，要麼坐公車上班。
He was born in Algeria and raised right here in Skikda.
他出生在阿爾及利亞，在斯基克達長大。
Tom and Mary are both still in Australia, aren't they?
湯姆和瑪麗都還在澳洲，對吧？
In Japan, it is polite to bow when one meets someone.
在日本，遇到人鞠躬是有禮貌的表現。
I'm tracking a buck.
我正在追蹤一頭公鹿。

entries.zh: 只,僅僅,才；絕對地；除...以外；但是
example: It might sound far-fetched, but this is a real problem.
這可能聽起來牽強，但卻是個真實的問題。
Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
好幾間小屋被洪水孤立起來了。

entries.zh: 次要的東西；(體育比賽中)輪空
example: He departed without so much as saying good bye.
他連再見也不說就走了。
The cab driver wasn't seriously injured.
計程車司機沒有受重傷。

entries.zh: 能,會；可能；可以；必須；能；罐頭
example: How can I feel relaxed, with you watching me like that?
你那麼看著我，我哪裡放鬆得下來啊？
I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
我不論甚麼時候都不該讓湯姆吃那麼多糖。
It goes without saying that money cannot buy happiness.
不言自明，金錢買不到幸福。

entries.zh: 把...裝入箱(或容器)中；盒子；案件
example: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.
萬一來不了，我會先給你打電話。
These cardboard boxes are a hundred per cent recyclable.
這些紙板盒是百分之百可回收的。
There is a certain amount of truth in what he's saying.
他說的話有一定的道理。
A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.
母雞孵蛋，孵出小雞。
"I hope we'll be home for Christmas", said the soldier.
士兵說道：“我希望聖誕節時我們能在家裡。”
The recipe calls this small sweet cake a cooky.
這份食譜把這種小甜餅稱為 cooky，也就是餅乾。
Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
爸爸說他明年就要被升為部門主管了。
Daddy was in his office, under our flat.
爸爸在他的辦公室裡，在我們公寓樓下。
The jealousy is starting to darken Tom's mind.
The Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.
日本人在一九四一年十二月七日襲擊珍珠港。
How would you define "happiness"?
你怎麼定義“幸福”？

entries.zh: 做；構成否定句,疑問句,或強調句
example: We will pay you according to the amount of work you do.
我們會按照你的工作量付錢給你。

entries.zh: [計] 通訊部, 數字輸出控制, 文件；[醫] 脫氧皮質酮
example: In short, it is because the 'plan.doc' file I attached in the previous email was infected with a virus.
簡單來說，就是因為我附在上一封電郵的「plan.doc」檔案被電腦病毒感染了。

entries.zh: 情緒低落,消沈；(分期付款的)第一期的；擊倒；向下；下降；(境況)變差；減少,減弱；向下；下降；蕭條；絨毛；有草丘陵地
entries.pos: 形容詞、動詞、副詞、介系詞、名詞
example: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
收音機太響了。你不能把音量調低一點嗎？
Tom has been to this park with Mary at least a dozen times.
湯姆跟瑪麗來這公園至少十二次。
Excessive drinking is one of the causes of impotence.
酗酒是導致陽痿的一個因素。
The small duckling can swim but has not demonstrated this ability.
A drop of mustard fell and stained my tie during lunch.
吃午飯的時候，一坨芥末醬滴下來弄髒了我的領帶。

entries.zh: 每個；各個(地)；各自(地)；每一個
example: Can you remember the first time that we met each other?
你還記得我們第一次見面的時候嗎？
Let's meet at the station at eight tomorrow morning.
明早八點車站見。
She came to Tokyo when she was eighteen years old.
她18歲的時候來到東京。
Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, hundred.
十、二十、三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十、一百。

entries.zh: 兩者之一；也；或者(和or連用)
example: I don't want to go there. He doesn't want to go either.
我不想去那兒，他也不想。
It is close to eleven. It's about time we went to bed.
快11點了。我們該上床睡覺了。
Tom is better at science than anyone else in his class.
湯姆的科學成績比班上的任何一個人都要好。

entries.zh: 英格蘭的；英國的；英國人的；英語的；英語
example: Don't be afraid to make mistakes when speaking English.
講英語的時候不要怕會不會說錯什麼。

entries.zh: 均勻的；偶數的；平手的；使平坦；弄平；使相等；即使

就算我的家發生火災，也會很快就被撲熄的。
This is the most beautiful sight that I have ever seen.
這是我見過最美的景色了。
Nowadays, almost every home has one or two televisions.
現在幾乎每家每戶也有一兩臺電視機了。

entries.zh: 每件事物, 所有事物

我們小時候，所有的一切對我們來說都顯得那麼大。。。

除了下雨天以外，他每天都會走路上班。
Excepting Sundays he works every day.
As far as I know, there is nothing wrong with his plan.
據我所知，他的計畫沒有出差錯。
The child who ate almost all this cake must be very fat.
這個幾乎吃掉了一整個蛋糕的孩子一定很胖。
He has not written to us since last February.
他從去年二月開始就沒寫信給我們。
She can express her feelings when she feels happy or sad.
當感到高興或悲傷時，她能表達感情。
Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
你的作文非常好，而且錯誤很少。
Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
栗子至少要煮15分鐘。
One hundred and fifty people entered the marathon race.
150個人參加了馬拉松比賽。
Damn, VS Code crashed and I haven’t saved the file yet.
操，VS Code崩潰了，我還沒儲存檔案。

entries.zh: 把...拍成電影；生薄膜；膠捲；影片
example: I am either going to see a film, or going to see an opera.
我或者去看電影，或者去看歌劇。

entries.zh: 好的；使純；澄清；使精細；細微地；精巧地；很好地；妙；好天氣；罰金,罰款

Ken 在爸爸生日的那天買了一瓶上好的酒送給他。

先熨燙領子的裡面，然後是外面。

已經五點了，我還沒有睡覺。
That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
那是無稽之談。只有傻瓜才會相信。
Were it not for music, the world would be a dull place.
如果沒有了音樂，這個世界就會變得十分沉悶。
He's a foreigner. He doesn't understand what we're saying.
他是老外,他聽不懂我們說的話。
Algeria is a big country of forty million inhabitants.
阿爾及利亞是四千萬人口大國。
I studied English for four years with a native speaker.
我跟英語母語者學了四年英語。
My father died of a subarachnoid hemorrhage when I was fourteen.
我十四歲的時候，父親死於蛛網膜下出血。
Yesterday was Friday; the day after tomorrow is Monday.
昨天是星期五，後天是星期一。
Judging from the look of the sky, it is likely to rain.
看看天的樣子，要下雨了。

entries.zh: 前面的；正面的；向前；在前面；面對；前方

在圖書館前有朋友在等我。

很少有學生能在古漢語考試上拿滿分。

別忘了一到倫敦就給我們留言啊。

約翰感覺到那黑漆漆的房間裡有鬼。
Seen from the sky, this river looks like a giant snake.
從天上看下來，這條河像一條巨蛇。
Here are the glasses, the plates and the serviettes.
這裡有玻璃杯、盤子和餐巾。
The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.
出國的人數一直在增加。
According to the Bible, God made the world in six days.
根據聖經記載，上帝用6天創造了世界。

帕查瑪瑪是安地斯山脈土著居民敬仰的大地和生育女神。

He left the room without so much as saying good-bye to me.
他連再見也沒說就離開了房間。
Goodbye! When you have more time, come back and play!
再見！有空多來玩兒！

可能我的孫子會是登陸火星的第一人。
Where's your granddaughter?
你的孫女在哪裡？
Sometimes, Grandma is more dangerous than the KGB.
有時候外婆比克格勃還危險。
My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.
我的祖父相信登月是一個騙局。
Perhaps my grandson will be the first person to land on Mars.
可能我的孫子會是登陸火星的第一人。

entries.zh: 灰色的；使成灰色；灰色；暗淡的光線
example: Have you seen a little child wearing a grey‑and‑white striped shirt?
你有看到過一個穿著灰白條紋襯衫的小孩子嗎？
Women eat lighter meals when they're eating with a guy.
當女性跟一個男人吃飯時，女性會吃得比較少。

entries.zh: 一半的,二分之一的；不完整的；部分地；相當地；一半地；幾乎；一半
example: More than half of the residents are opposed to the plan.
有過半數的居民反對這個計劃。

我認為你該吃火腿三明治。
During my free time I like to hang out with my friends.
在我閒暇之時我喜歡和朋友們聚聚。

好幾間小屋被洪水孤立起來了。

我跟湯姆問好的時候，他躲在他媽媽身後。

他喜歡我！—廚師的母雞說。

從這裡步行到車站要多少時間？

你那麼看著我，我哪裡放鬆得下來啊？

不論黑暗多麼遼闊，我們都必須提供自身的光明。

150個人參加了馬拉松比賽。
I want to go on a journey around the world if possible.
如果可能的話我想去世界各地旅行。

entries.zh: 在裡面的；進；在裡頭；在家；在…之內

我太太兼職的工作賺進了一些額外的錢。
He was beaten to within an inch of his life.
他被毆打得快死。

entries.zh: 裡面的,內側的；內幕的；在裡面；往裡面；在…裡面；內部,裡面；內幕
entries.pos: 形容詞、副詞、介系詞、名詞
example: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
先熨燙領子的裡面，然後是外面。
The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
神話讓我們能透悉古文明。

entries.zh: 是,在；be動詞第三人稱,單數,現在式
example: It might sound far-fetched, but this is a real problem.
這可能聽起來牽強，但卻是個真實的問題。

我給客服打電話，因為他們給我寄錯貨了。

2025 年 1 月 20 日，精神病患接管了精神病院。

entries.zh: 正直的；公平的；應得的；正確的；正好；剛才

就在他要出門的時候，發生了強震。

要是這是場夢，我會把那個把我叫起來的人殺掉。

這類植物只生長在熱帶地區。
Is there anyone who wants to keep the cute kitten?
有沒有人要養可愛的小貓？
Cookie scratched Tom in the face when he called him "kitty".

entries.zh: 最後的；持續；最後地；最後的人(或東西)；最後；上回

昨晚我還沒有睡覺家裡就被小偷光顧了

我剛知道你在生病，所以下了班來看望你。

entries.zh: 引導；指導；領先地位；線索,鉛筆心

我從她那裡拿了一根自動鉛筆芯。

entries.zh: 最小的；最少的；最不重要的；最小；最少；最不
example: My brother is very important. At least he thinks he is.
我弟弟非常重要。至少他認為他是。

entries.zh: 左邊的；在左邊；向左；左,左邊；激進分子們
example: Mary said she wished she hadn't left the door unlocked.
瑪麗表示她希望她沒忘了鎖門。

entries.zh: 較少的；較小地,較少地；不如；減去；扣除；差...

他越通曉這個語言, 他越不喜歡它。
Tom said that he hopes that you won't let Mary do that.
湯姆說他希望你不會讓瑪麗那麼做。

entries.zh: 水平的,平的；筆直的；水平線
example: I must say that your writing is at a pretty good level!
我必須說, 你的寫作達到了非常好的水準。
You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.
你的臉色這麼差，還是趕快去睡覺吧。
How can I feel relaxed, with you watching me like that?
你那麼看著我，我哪裡放鬆得下來啊？
Dad, I am pregnant. Here is the list of the suspects...
爸爸，我懷孕了。這是我男朋友們的名單……

entries.zh: 很少的；一點點；沒有多少；短時間；短距離
example: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
我太太兼職的工作賺進了一些額外的錢。
When I first came back to Boston, I was really lonely.
當我第一次回波士頓時，我真是孤獨。

entries.zh: 長的；長久地；始終；渴望；長久地；始終

從這裡步行到車站要多少時間？

我們在探險的時候遇到了很多困難。
The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
收音機太響了。你不能把音量調低一點嗎？
There are four lovely children in this photo.
這張照片上有四個可愛的孩子。

entries.zh: 低的；矮的；低,向下地；低聲地；低價地；低水平,低點；；低速

我存在銀行的錢利息非常低。

Lao Gan Ma and I have a love-hate relationship.
我和老乾媽有愛恨交加的關係。
I know you're probably mad about what I said yesterday.
我知道我昨天說的那番話把你弄得很生氣。

entries.zh: 不可思議的；有魔力的；魔術
example: This monster only takes magic damage.
這個怪物只吃魔法傷害。

entries.zh: 最主要的；總管道；主要部分；要點
example: That wasn't the main reason that Tom needed to do that.
這不是湯姆要做那件事的主要原因。
Mama had a crippled face.
媽媽有一張殘缺的臉。
Mamma Leone’s, in New York, helped bring Italian cuisine to the American masses.
That man knows how to get on the president's good side.
那人很會討好老闆。

計算機產業能夠提供相當多的就業崗位。
Mark is so honest that everybody commends him for it.
馬克是如此的誠實所以每個人都讚揚他。

entries.zh: 已婚的, 婚姻的；[法] 結了婚的, 有配偶的, 夫婦的
example: Everyone opposed it, but they got married all the same.
他們不理眾人的反對結了婚。

他既精於數學又精於文學。
Euclid was the author of the first book on mathematics.
歐幾裡得是第一本數學著作的作者。

我期待聽到你在這件事上的想法 。
This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
這個故事聽起來可能很奇怪，但卻是千真萬確的。
This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
這個故事聽起來可能很奇怪，但卻是千真萬確的。
Maybe I'll just give up soon and take a nap instead.
也許我會馬上放棄然後去打盹。
Swimming in the sea does not mean you own the ocean.
在海裡游泳並不意味著就擁有大海。
Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.
僅三分之一的成員出席了會議。

entries.zh: 中間的；放在中間；對摺；中央
example: The bus stopped suddenly in the middle of the street.
巴士突然在路中心停了下來。
The universe is about 13.75 thousand million years old.
宇宙的年齡大約為137.5億年。
Just as food feeds the body, so reading feeds the mind.
就像食物餵養身體，所以閱讀餵養心靈。

entries.zh: 開礦；佈雷；破壞；我的東西；礦；源泉；地雷；坑道
example: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
我的一個女性朋友喜歡跟我一起去同志酒吧。
He hurried to the station so he wouldn't miss the train.
為了不錯過火車，他匆匆趕往了車站。
Why is there a Miss Italy but no Mister Italy?
為什麼有義大利小姐卻沒有義大利先生？
Why is there a Miss Italy but no Mister Italy?
為什麼有義大利小姐卻沒有義大利先生？
Modern man has moved far away from God and from nature.
現代人已經偏離上帝和自然了。
I can't look at this painting without thinking of my mom.
我無法看著這幅畫而不想起我母親。
The moment I held the baby in my arms, it began to cry.
我一把孩子抱在手裡，他就開始哭了。
Mommy, why don't I have an uncle with a beard?
媽媽，為什麼我沒有長鬍子的舅舅呢？
Yesterday was Friday; the day after tomorrow is Monday.
昨天是星期五，後天是星期一。
The one resource more precious than any other was land.
唯一比無論什麼資源都珍貴的是土地。

entries.zh: 最多的；大部分的；最；最多；非常,很
example: This is the most beautiful sight that I have ever seen.
這是我見過最美的景色了。
Mr. Lin is waiting outside the classroom.
林先生正在教室外等候。

entries.zh: a. 夫人；[網路] 太太；女士；某太太
example: Mrs. Chen teaches English at our school.
陳太太在我們學校教英文。
Please ask Ms. Wang to join the meeting.
請邀請王女士參加會議。

entries.zh: 很多的；非常；很；差不多,幾乎

你花多長時間漢語學這麼好。
People who play with mud will get their hands dirty.
玩泥的人會弄髒自己的雙手。
Mummy has to do the washing this afternoon.
媽媽下午要洗衣服。

entries.zh: 必須；必須做的事；不可少的事物
example: We must consider the financial aspects of this project.
我們必須從財政方面考慮一下這個計劃。
Promoting Mandarin Chinese is China's national plan.
推行普通話，是中國的國策。

entries.zh: 近的；近,接近；幾乎,差不多；近地；接近
entries.pos: 形容詞、動詞、副詞、介系詞
example: I really look forward to your visit in the near future.
我很期待在不久的將來您的光臨。

entries.zh: 摟著脖子親吻；變細；變狹窄；脖子
example: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
他大喊的時候，脖子上青筋暴起。
The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.
漁民用他的網捕到了一隻紫色的水母。
I never see this picture without thinking of my father.
我看到這張照片時總是想起我父親。
The climate of New Zealand is similar to that of Japan.
紐西蘭和日本的氣候差不多一樣。

entries.zh: 下一個；接下去,然後；下次；第二
example: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?
能不能麻煩你告訴我去鄰村怎麼走？
If the weather is nice tomorrow, we will have a picnic.
如果明天天氣好，我們就去野餐。
At nine in the evening, we visited the Anne Frank House.
晚上九點的時候，我們參觀了安娜·弗蘭克的家。
It's amazing that he won the championship at the age of nineteen.
My grandmother is already more than ninety years old.
我祖母已經九十多歲了。

entries.zh: 沒有；不；不；不；沒有；拒絕；反對票
example: When she saw that they had no schools, she started one.
當她發現他們還沒有學校，她就辦了一個。
Nobody would've gotten hurt if we'd been more careful.
如果當時候我們更小心點， 沒有人會受傷了。

我在自己家中哪裡都不能讀書，那裡太吵了。
The train will probably arrive at the station before noon.
火車大概會在中午前到站。

entries.zh: (否定的答話)不是；沒有；不可以
example: Nope, I'm not buying it.
不，我不買它。

往北拐彎走到第二條弄堂就是。

entries.zh: 探問,探著；引導；嗅,聞；鼻子

我剛開啟鍋蓋，一股惡臭就撲鼻而來。

我們應該盡力不要汙染環境。

entries.zh: 注意；記下；筆記；音符；記錄；便條
example: Don't you think you ought to write them a thank-you note?
你不覺得你應該給他們寫一封感謝信嗎？

據我所知，他的計畫沒有出差錯。

真對不起，剛才都怪我，沒注意到您。

今天是二〇一六年十一月二十三日。
If I had bought the painting then, I would be rich now.
如果當時買了那幅畫，我現在就是一個富翁了。

entries.zh: 編號,總數達到,共計；號碼；數字

出國的人數一直在增加。

快到七時了。我們要上學了。

我可以坐在你旁邊嗎？

湯姆說他必須在十月二十日去看牙醫。

我們會按照你的工作量付錢給你。

entries.zh: 離去的；偏離的；休假的；關著的；脫下；離去
example: Don't forget to turn off the TV before you go to sleep.
別忘記尼你睡覺前關閉電視。

警官逮捕了竊賊。
Children often send letters to Santa with their wishes.
小朋友們經常給聖誕老人寫信，許下自己的願望。

原材料的價格如石油或者煤的不停地上升。

entries.zh: 好吧；尚可；挺好；批准；尚可；挺好；對吧；認可,批准

只要不是致命性的錯誤，失敗也沒關係。

不要再假裝一切都好了，不是這樣的！

如果你想安享晚年，現在就要開始儲蓄了。

我期待聽到你在這件事上的想法 。

entries.zh: 一次；一旦,一經...便；一次,一回

你的臉色這麼差，還是趕快去睡覺吧。

entries.zh: 一個的；一；一個人；一件事物

當她發現他們還沒有學校，她就辦了一個。

過兩天就可以在網上訂火車票了。

僅三分之一的成員出席了會議。

不知怎麼我總是沒心情工作。

唯一比無論什麼資源都珍貴的是土地。

著火的時候我媽媽恰好在那。

先熨燙領子的裡面，然後是外面。

我們最近十年經歷了很多變化。

你成功與否取決於你自身的努力。

我們的火車明天下午三點出發。

我爸爸每天抽一包煙。

他在郵局給朋友寄包裹。

我買了這雙鞋，但是有點太小了。

我什麼都不需要……只要一條新褲子。

烏古斯語支是突厥語系的一部分。

這幾年的天氣很反常。

entries.zh: 寫；寫作；囚禁；原子筆；墨水筆
example: Dad gave me a book, and my little brother gave me a pen.
爸爸給了我一本書, 弟弟給了我一枝筆。

是警察，也許我們應該讓道。

親吻一個抽菸的人就像在舔菸灰缸。

美國政府一直視英國為美國的寵物。

那通電話是引他離開房子的一個小把戲。

你必須把你的照片貼在申請書上。

我祖父的照片在牆上掛著。

她把大部分的空餘時間都花在彈鋼琴上。

entries.zh: 採收；撿起；選；精華,最好的部分；收穫(量)

不久，同樣的服務員回來拿起菜。

如果明天天氣好，我們就去野餐。

我看著奶奶從烤箱裡拿出一個金黃色的奶油派。

entries.zh: 拼湊；拼合；修理；修補；件；片

請你幫我在這張紙上畫個草圖。

entries.zh: 生小豬；像豬一樣過活；豬

羊毛出在豬身上，狗來買單。

entries.zh: 釘住；壓住；按住；把...歸罪於；大頭針；胸針

安靜到連針掉在地上的聲音你都會聽得到。

蜂蜜蛋糕是一隻白色的小貓，有著紫色的眼睛和粉紅色的鼻子。

entries.zh: 用管道輸送；吹奏管樂；尖聲叫嚷；管子

他口裡含著菸斗,坐在那兒.

由於天氣不好，飛機遲到了3小時。
Saturn is the second largest planet in the Solar System.
土星是太陽系中第二大的行星。
A picnic is easier on everyone if you use a paper plate.
用紙質餐盤的話，野餐就方便多了。
I don't have a CD player, but I bought the CD anyway.
我沒有 CD 播放機，但還是把唱片買下來了。
Please mind the gap between the train and the platform.
請小心月臺與車廂之間的空隙。
The lonely man derives pleasure from observing ants.
那個孤僻的人以觀察螞蟻取樂。

entries.zh: 出納員, 軍需官；[計] 調相, 效能管理, 處理模組, 程式儲存器

entries.zh: 侵吞；擊(球)落袋；忍受；口袋

他從他外套內袋裡拿出皮夾。

entries.zh: 瞄準；指出；強調；對準；點；要點

我習慣在睡覺前把鞋擦亮。

我建議，為了禮貌起見，我們儘可能少喝。

微風在湖面上掀起了一絲絲漣漪。

entries.zh: 合辦,聯營；水池；美式撞球
example: I applied for a job as a lifeguard at the community pool.
我去了公共游泳池應徵當救生員。

可憐的人民任憑殘暴的獨裁者處置。
Pour melted butter over the popcorn.
將融化了的奶油倒入爆米花中。

entries.zh: 把...放在罐(或鍋)裡；亂射；罐；鍋

如果你喝速溶咖啡，就不需要咖啡壺了。

我不該把一整包薯片都吃完的。

entries.zh: 給...提供動力；快速前進；權力；動力
example: Plans are being drawn up to build a power station here.
這裡正在籌劃建設一座發電站。

entries.zh: 出席的；當前的；現在式的；提出；禮物

這是我收過最好的禮物了。

我必須說, 你的寫作達到了非常好的水準。

entries.zh: 為...安排節目；設計電腦程式；節目

假如你沒有這個程式，你現在就可以去下載。

他對自己在美國讀過書這件事感到很驕傲。

entries.zh: 公開的；公立的；公眾,民眾

展覽大大地吸引了公眾的注意。
Could you please pull the weeds and water the flowers?
你可不可以幫忙除草澆花？
I have to push my bike because one of the tyres is flat.
我得推我的腳踏車，因為有個輪胎漏氣了。
Even if my house catches fire it would soon be put out.
就算我的家發生火災，也會很快就被撲熄的。

entries.zh: 把...四等分；供...住宿；；駐紮；¼；美金25分；15分鐘
example: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
企業第一季度收益大幅增長。
The Queen has gone to a lot of trouble for the Duchess.
女王為公爵夫人費心做了很多。
I just had a quick look. It wasn't interesting at all.
我剛才瞧了一眼，一點沒意思。
I was quite thirsty and wanted to drink something cool.
我很渴，想喝點冷飲。
It's difficult to catch a rabbit with your bare hands.
徒手逮兔挺難。

entries.zh: 與...賽跑；競賽；(生物的)種類
example: One hundred and fifty people entered the marathon race.
150個人參加了馬拉松比賽。
The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
收音機太響了。你不能把音量調低一點嗎？
A rainbow is one of the most beautiful phenomena of nature.
彩虹是自然界最美的現象之一。
He goes to work on foot every day except on rainy days.
除了下雨天以外，他每天都會走路上班。

entries.zh: 舉起；提高；加薪；賭注加碼
example: If you have a question, please raise your right hand.
如果有問題，請舉起你的右手。
Columbus argued that he could reach India by going west.
哥倫布提出，向西航行可以到達印度。
It might sound far-fetched, but this is a real problem.
這可能聽起來牽強，但卻是個真實的問題。

entries.zh: 實際上, 真實地, 實在
example: I really look forward to your visit in the near future.
我很期待在不久的將來您的光臨。
For some reason or other I cannot bring myself to work.
不知怎麼我總是沒心情工作。
Many Chinese people consider red to be the best colour.
很多中國人認為紅色是最好的顏色。
A close neighbor is better than a distant relative.
遠親不如近鄰。

entries.zh: 重複；重複；重播；複寫；副本；
example: Let us repeat: cup, plate, knife, fork, spoon, teaspoon.
再念一次：杯子、盤子、刀、叉、湯匙、茶匙。
Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
在明天前完成報告幾乎是不可能的。
The reporter criticized the politician.
記者批評了政治家。
If I had bought the painting then, I would be rich now.
如果當時買了那幅畫，我現在就是一個富翁了。

entries.zh: 右邊；對的；向右地；馬上；公理；權利
example: He doesn't know the difference between right and wrong.
他好壞不分。
Kurt didn't wake up yesterday because the alarm didn't ring.
昨天鬧鐘沒響，Kurt也就沒醒過來。

entries.zh: 起身；升起；(數量,程度等)增加,上漲；上升
example: This picture frame can make the picture rise in value.
這個畫框能讓畫升值。
Each robot is equipped with a talking machine.
每個機器人身上都安裝了一臺發聲器。
Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
你比較喜歡哪一個，搖滾樂還是古典音樂？

entries.zh: 捲；滾；滾動；(一)捲；捲餅；隆隆聲；名單
example: Would you like to eat a roll for lunch?
你午飯想吃麵包嗎？
We learned at school that the square root of nine is three.
我們上課時學了九的根是三。
The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
獵人們用堅韌的繩網把野生動物捉住了。
Today, the temperature rose as high as 30 degrees Celsius.
今天的氣溫升高到攝氏三十度。

entries.zh: 圓形的；變圓；發胖；兜圈子,環行；環繞地；循環地；在附近；逐一,挨次；圍繞,環繞；在...附近；大約；一輪,一回合,一場,一局；圓形物
entries.pos: 形容詞、動詞、副詞、介系詞、名詞
example: Nuts are round, but not everything that's round is a nut.
堅果是圓的，但不是光是圓的就是堅果。
There's a row of ants coming in and out of the kitchen.
有一排螞蟻在廚房裡進進出出。
I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.
我規定自己在九點之後不看電視。
Since ancient times, it has always been the commoners who tolerate their ruler.
自古至今，容忍的總是老百姓，被容忍的總是統治者。
She can express her feelings when she feels happy or sad.
當感到高興或悲傷時，她能表達感情。
Mary put some roasted pecans into her salad.
瑪莉在沙拉裡放了一些烤山核桃。
The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
這場減價活動會持續三天，從今天開始。

entries.zh: 鹹水的；含鹽的；(故事,笑話等)猥褻的；給...加鹽；用鹽醃；鹽
example: Choose food low in fat, sugar and salt, and high in fibre.
挑選少油、少糖、少鹽和高纖的食物。
Everyone opposed it, but they got married all the same.
他們不理眾人的反對結了婚。
Bob worked as a clerk in the grocery store on Saturday.
每週六鮑勃在雜貨店做店員。
I must say that your writing is at a pretty good level!
我必須說, 你的寫作達到了非常好的水準。
Please have a seat and wait until your name is called.
請在被叫到名字之前坐在椅子上等候。

entries.zh: 第二的；次要的,副的,從屬的；居第二位；第二,其次；第二；秒
example: Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
威廉王子是英國王位第二順位繼承人。
My sister worked as a secretary before she got married.
我的姐姐結婚前是個秘書.
I ordered a sesame seed buns for the veggie burgers.
我點了一份芝麻麵包，用來製作素食漢堡。
He is badly off, because his book doesn't sell well.
他的書銷路不好，所以現在手頭十分拮据。
Children often send letters to Santa with their wishes.
小朋友們經常給聖誕老人寫信，許下自己的願望。
I do not understand the exact meaning of this sentence.
我不是很清楚這個句子的意思。
The jobless rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September 2015.
在2015年9月日本的失業率為3.4％。
Tom sustained serious burns and had to go to the hospital.
湯姆嚴重燒傷，不得不去醫院治療。
Sami doesn't know how he survived in customer service.
莎米不知道自己是如何在客服崗位上生存下來的。
You've got to set the alarm clock before you go to bed.
在你上床睡覺之前，你必須把鬧鐘設定好。
The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
委員會是由三男七女組成的。
A boy of seventeen is often as tall as his father.
十七歲的男孩常常長得和他父親一樣高。
The temperature today is seventy degrees Fahrenheit.
今天氣溫是華氏七十度。
Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
好幾間小屋被洪水孤立起來了。
When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.
和別人握手的時候，一定要有眼神接觸。
We shall fix all bugs today before leaving the office.
我們應該在今天下班前解決所有bug。
My father has been in good shape since his operation.
自從手術後，我父親一直處於良好的狀態。

entries.zh: 尖銳的；敏銳的；整(指時刻)；銳利地；機警地
example: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
他的觀察是敏銳的，但他沒有說太多。
Do you want to trade our two sheep, one for another?
你想把我們的兩隻羊一換一嗎？

entries.zh: 用船運；郵寄；解雇；上船,乘船；船
example: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
這艘船逆風而行緩慢前進。
I'd like to exchange this shirt that I bought yesterday.
我想去換我昨天買的這件襯衫。
There was some chewing gum on the sole of Tom's shoe.
湯姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。
Jane had her hair cut short before the athletic meet.
Jane在運動會之前把頭髮剃短了。
Khaki shorts with cargo pockets do not make you an adventurer.
單有卡其褲，還成不了冒險家。

entries.zh: 肩起,挑起；擔負,承擔；肩膀
example: My shoulder hurts so much, I don't know what to do.
我的肩膀很痛，我不知道怎麼辦。
All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.
突然間她開始用尖銳的聲音大喊。
I was caught in a shower and got drenched to the skin.
我遇上了陣雨被淋得全身濕透。
Smokers take twice as many days off sick as non-smokers.
吸煙的人請病假的日數比不吸煙的人多兩倍。
That man knows how to get on the president's good side.
那人很會討好老闆。

entries.zh: 看見,發現；瞄準；察看；視力；景象
example: This is the most beautiful sight that I have ever seen.
這是我見過最美的景色了。
Rebels stomped on the enemy’s flags as a sign of defiance.
反叛者踐踏敵人的旗幟，以示挑釁。
This little story is too simple to explain everything.
這小故事太簡單說明一切。

entries.zh: 此後；之前,以前；由於；自從...之後；自...以來；因為
example: He and I have been good friends since we were children.
我和他從小就是好朋友了。
Mary discovered that Tom was secretly a talented singer.
瑪莉發現湯姆其實是一位很有才華的歌手。
Sir, I would like to deposit my money. How do I do that?
先生，我要存錢，怎麼存？
Don't sit here if you're not going to play poker with us.
不跟我們玩撲克就不要坐在這裡。
According to the Bible, God made the world in six days.
根據聖經記載，上帝用6天創造了世界。
Only sixteen percent of the teachers at the school are female.
這所學校的老師只有百分之十六是女性。
An hour has sixty minutes, and a minute has sixty seconds.
一個小時有六十分鐘，一分鐘有六十秒。

entries.zh: 按一定尺寸製作；估算；大小；尺寸
example: To date nobody knows the actual size of the cosmos.
宇宙的實際大小至今無人知道。
That was the skirt that Mary bought yesterday.
這條裙子就是瑪麗昨天買的那條
Judging from the look of the sky, it is likely to rain.
看看天的樣子，要下雨了。

entries.zh: 細長的；微小的；減肥；減少,縮減
example: She has blonde hair and a slim figure.
她有著一頭金髮，瘦高的身材。

entries.zh: 緩慢的；使慢,放慢；慢慢地；遲遲地；慢了地
example: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
這艘船逆風而行緩慢前進。

entries.zh: 小的；小聲地；小小地,細小地；細小的部分；小件物品
example: I'm only going to write small sentences without commas.
我只是想寫一些沒有逗號的小句子。
Tom is probably not as smart as you think he is.
湯姆沒有你想的那麼聰明。

entries.zh: 聞；氣味；香味；臭味；嗅覺；一嗅,一聞；少許；跡象,影蹤
example: I just opened the lid, and a foul smell filled my nose.
我剛開啟鍋蓋，一股惡臭就撲鼻而來。
Sometimes I smoke just to give my hands something to do.
有時我吸菸只是因為要給我手頭點事做。
Seen from the sky, this river looks like a giant snake.
從天上看下來，這條河像一條巨蛇。
The weather report says we'll get three inches of snow.
天氣預報說會下三英寸雪。
This song is so moving that it brings tears to my eyes.
這首歌太感人了，使我不禁流下了眼淚。
Tom found Mary's necklace under the sofa.
在沙發下，湯姆找到了瑪麗的項鍊。
"I hope we'll be home for Christmas", said the soldier.
士兵說道：“我希望聖誕節時我們能在家裡。”
We've been matched up with some strong teams this year.
我們今年和不少強隊交過手。
I'm afraid I can't help you. You must ask someone else.
我擔心可能幫不了你，你需要找其他人幫忙。

entries.zh: 某人；某事；重要的人(或事物)；
example: She needed some money to buy something to feed her dog.
她需要一些錢來買點東西喂她的狗。
Sometimes I smoke just to give my hands something to do.
有時我吸菸只是因為要給我手頭點事做。
Books are for people who wish they were somewhere else.
書是為了那些希望自己在另一個地方的人。
The parents want to give their son the best education.
父母想給兒子最好的教育。
This song is so moving that it brings tears to my eyes.
這首歌太感人了，使我不禁流下了眼淚。
Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
別忘了一到倫敦就給我們留言啊。

entries.zh: 疼痛的；痛處；瘡,潰瘍；傷心事
example: Mother applied the medicine to the sore on my knee.
母親把藥膏塗在了我膝蓋的傷口上。
Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?
能不能麻煩你告訴我去鄰村怎麼走？

entries.zh: 完好的；堅固的；合理的,明智的；殷實的；聽起來；聲音
example: It might sound far-fetched, but this is a real problem.
這可能聽起來牽強，但卻是個真實的問題。
There is a saying: cabbage soup and porridge are our food.
俗話說：高麗菜湯和粥是我們的食物。
This is how Scott and his men arrived at the South Pole.
這是史考特和他的夥伴到達南極的方法。
Space travel will be commonplace some time in the future.
太空旅行終有一天會成為平常事。
This year is definitely a special year in human history.
今年肯定是人類歷史上特殊的一年。
The wicked witch cast a spell on the man and turned him into a bug.
惡毒的巫婆在男人身上施了咒語，把他變成了一隻蟲子。
I didn't want to spend any more time arguing with Tom.
我不想再花時間跟湯姆討論了。
It is a Chinese tradition to welcome spring with flowers.
用花迎春是中國的傳統。
We learned at school that the square root of nine is three.
我們上課時學了九的根是三。
After the accident, he was physically challenged by even a single stair.

entries.zh: 主演；表現出色；星星；明星
example: The nearest star to our solar system is Proxima Centauri.
離我們太陽系最近的恆星是比鄰星。
I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
我開始懷疑他陳述的準確性。

entries.zh: 駐紮,部署,配置；車站；場所
example: How long does it take to walk from here to the station?
從這裡步行到車站要多少時間？

entries.zh: 停留；停留,逗留；停止；延後；持續力
example: If you don't want to stay alone, I can keep you company.
如果你不想一個人待著，我可以陪著你。
Last night my house was robbed while I was still awake.
昨晚我還沒有睡覺家裡就被小偷光顧了

entries.zh: 貯存；收存；供應；蓄有；商店
example: Bob worked as a clerk in the grocery store on Saturday.
每週六鮑勃在雜貨店做店員。

entries.zh: 直的；直,挺直地；正直地；立刻；直,挺直；(紙牌)五張順牌
example: I recognised her straight away; she hasn't changed a bit.
我一下子就認出她了，她一點兒都沒變。
This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
這個故事聽起來可能很奇怪，但卻是千真萬確的。
He was nearly hit by the car while crossing the street.
他過馬路時差點被車撞。
Specialists are people who have only one string on their violin.
專家就好像一臺只有一根弦的小提琴一樣。
We've been matched up with some strong teams this year.
我們今年和不少強隊交過手。
Nakamatsu smiled bitterly at his own stupid question.
中松為自己的愚蠢問題苦笑。
Philosophy is not a written subject, but a way of life.
哲學不是書面上的學問，而是一種生活的方式。
The only way I can eat porridge is with lots of sugar.
唯有加很多糖才能讓我喝得下粥。
I can't survive without air conditioning in the summer.
我夏天沒有空調會死。
She will return home next Sunday, that is, the tenth.
她下週日回家，也就是10號。
Tomorrow's weather should be sunny with occasional rain.
明天天氣晴轉陣雨。
Could you tell how to get to the nearest supermarket?
你能告訴我怎麼去最近的超市嗎？
Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
別忘了一到倫敦就給我們留言啊。
The Tigers lost the game, which was a surprise to us.
我們覺得很驚訝老虎隊竟然輸掉了比賽。
I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.
我很驚訝，你竟然不知道他們結婚了。

entries.zh: 甜的；(餐後的)甜點；(用作稱呼語)親愛的,寶貝
example: Hummingbirds drink the sweet nectar from certain flowers.
蜂鳥會吸食某些花朵的甜美花蜜。
Karl wore a blue t-shirt and jeans.
卡爾穿著藍色 T 恤和牛仔褲。

entries.zh: 尾隨；盯梢；變少,縮小；尾巴
example: Just as if it were my tail, wherever I go, it goes too.
它就像我的尾巴一樣，我去哪裡它就去哪裡。
I leave it in your hands what course of action to take.
接下來該採取什麼行動就交給你了。

entries.zh: 講話；談話；交談；空話；話題；談判
example: Those who know do not talk. Those who talk do not know.
知道的不說，說的不知道。
She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
她是個又高又瘦, 留著一頭又長又軟的褐色頭髮的女孩。

entries.zh: 用帶子捆紮；用錄音帶為...錄音(或影)；錄音帶；錄影帶；膠帶
example: My cassette tape recorder needs fixing.
我的磁帶錄音機需要維修。

entries.zh: 嘗；味道,滋味；體驗；風雅；得體；興趣
example: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
葡萄酒的味道很受天氣影響。
When he arrived at the train station he called a taxi.
他到了火車站，就叫了輛計程車。
Call a taxicab to take us.
叫輛計程車來接我們。
Please bring us two cups of tea and one cup of coffee.
請來兩杯茶和一杯咖啡。
Between you and me, I don't like our new team captain.
我就只告訴你，我不喜歡我們的新隊長。
Dan dated Linda when she was a teenager.
丹在琳達十幾歲的時候就與她交往過。
Tom asked Mary if she knew John's new telephone number.
湯姆問瑪麗是否知道瓊的新電話號碼。
It is true that television also has some disadvantages.
電視的確有一些缺點。
We were all ears when he started to tell us his secret.
他開始說他的秘密的時候，我們都豎起了耳朵來聽。
Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?
您知道這座廟宇供奉的是哪個神嗎？
One person hides something, and ten people look for it.
一個人藏，十個人找。
When I was in Salem, I would often play tennis with John.
當我在塞勒姆的時候, 我常常和約翰打網球。
Many soldiers suffered terrible wounds in the battle.
很多士兵在這場戰役中嚴重受傷。
Tom looked worried about the result of an English test.
Tom看上去對英語測試的結果很擔心。
The one resource more precious than any other was land.
唯一比無論什麼資源都珍貴的是土地。
This song is so moving that it brings tears to my eyes.
這首歌太感人了，使我不禁流下了眼淚。
We will pay you according to the amount of work you do.
我們會按照你的工作量付錢給你。
She would often go to the theater when she was in London.
她在倫敦的時候，曾經常去劇院。

entries.zh: 當時的；當時；之後；那麼；那時,當時
example: If I had bought the painting then, I would be rich now.
如果當時買了那幅畫，我現在就是一個富翁了。
My mother happened to be there when the fire broke out.
著火的時候我媽媽恰好在那。
I can't swallow these tablets without a drink of water.
不喝水我咽不下這些藥片。
Because of the thick fog, the road was hard to see.
因為大霧所以看不清道路。
She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
她是個又高又瘦, 留著一頭又長又軟的褐色頭髮的女孩。
Don't bother your parents with such a pointless thing.
別為了這樣的小事麻煩你父母。

entries.zh: 第三；第三名；第三；三分之一
example: Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.
僅三分之一的成員出席了會議。
My mother put thirteen candles on my birthday cake.
母親在我的生日蛋糕上插上了十三枝蠟燭。
It was not until he was thirty that he started to paint.
他到了三十歲才開始畫畫。
It might sound far-fetched, but this is a real problem.
這可能聽起來牽強，但卻是個真實的問題。
Will you help me give out the programs to those people?
你能幫我給這些人分發節目單嗎？

entries.zh: (一般放在句尾)然而,還是；雖然
example: Even though Tom studied very hard, he failed the class.
即使湯姆很集中的學習，他失敗了課。
Several thousand people became victims of this disease.
數千人受此疾病所害。
The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
委員會是由三男七女組成的。
Tom cleared his throat and continued to speak.
湯姆咳嗽了一下然後接著講。

entries.zh: 穿過,通過；從頭至尾；(電話)接通；經過
example: Love is like the measles; we all have to go through it.
愛情就像麻疹──一生總要經歷一次。

entries.zh: 投；拋；投擲；披巾；(沙發等的)罩單
example: Don't throw away this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
這本雜誌不要扔。我還沒看呢。
We have to be done with everything by Thursday morning.
週四早上之前我們要全部完成。
We will tidy up our room so that Mom is satisfied.
我們將要整理房間，這樣媽媽就會滿意了。
A drop of mustard fell and stained my tie during lunch.
吃午飯的時候，一坨芥末醬滴下來弄髒了我的領帶。
2010 was the Year of the Tiger in the Chinese lunar calendar.
2010年是農曆的虎年。

entries.zh: 給小費；使傾斜；尖端；小費
example: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
矛尖浸在一種致命的毒藥裡。

entries.zh: 疲累的, 疲乏的, 厭倦的
example: The only person who is tired of waiting for Miss Cobb.
期望 Cobb 小姐回來的唯一一人。
I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
我期待聽到你在這件事上的想法 。
You killed my father, and today I'll have my vengeance.
你殺了我父親，我今天要為他報仇。
He was soaking wet from head to toe.
他從頭到腳都溼透了。
Let's go out and eat dinner together from time to time.
讓我們偶爾出去一起吃晚餐。
Tom dreams of the toilet when he has to go to the bathroom.
湯姆在需要上廁所的時候會夢見廁所。
The tomato is subject to a number of diseases.
番茄容易遭受很多病害。
Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
在明天前完成報告幾乎是不可能的。
The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.
今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。
The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
收音機太響了。你不能把音量調低一點嗎？
I need a tool for pulling weeds in my garden.
我需要工具來給花園除草。
You should go to the dentist and have that tooth pulled out.
你應該去看牙醫，把牙拔掉。

entries.zh: 最高的；向高處升；達到頂點；高出；超越；頂部；陀螺
example: All the top teams in England are in the Premier League.
英國所有的頂尖球隊都在超級聯賽中。
I chose this topic because I think it is interesting.
我選這個主題是因為我覺得它很有意思。
This trip of mine would need twelve days in total.
我這趟旅程一共需要十二天。

entries.zh: 觸摸；觸,碰；接觸；潤色；特長,才能；少許
example: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯絡。
She came out of the bathroom with a towel wrapped around her.
她圍著一條浴巾從浴室走了出來。
Public morals are not respected anymore in this town.
在這座城市裡，公共道德不再受到尊重。

entries.zh: 玩弄,戲耍；調情,調戲；玩具
example: Tom appealed to his mother to buy a new toy for him.
湯姆請求媽媽給他買新玩具。

entries.zh: 在...上通行；交易,來來往往；交通
example: How can there be a traffic jam now, as late as 6 o'clock?
現在才6點半，怎麼會堵車呢？

entries.zh: 訓練,培養；瞄準；接受訓練,鍛鍊；火車
example: The train is traveling at the rate of 50 miles an hour.
火車以每小時50英里的速度前行。
What time will you get back? I'll treat you to a meal.
你什麼時候回來？請你吃一頓飯。
There used to be a big pine tree in front of my house.
以前我家前面有棵大松樹。

entries.zh: 絆,絆倒；失足,犯錯誤；旅行；旅行
example: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.
一個入室盜竊者趁我去旅遊的時候闖入了我家。
The Queen has gone to a lot of trouble for the Duchess.
女王為公爵夫人費心做了很多。
This truck transports fresh food from Aomori to Tokyo.
這輛卡車從青森運輸新鮮食品到東京。
I will try not to interrupt you while you are studying.
我會盡量不打擾你複習。
The professor has office hours every Tuesday afternoon.
每個星期二下午是這個教授的辦公時間。
The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
收音機太響了。你不能把音量調低一點嗎？

entries.zh: 電視；[計] 電視, 轉移向量
example: According to TV news, there was a plane crash in India.
根據電視新聞，一架飛機在印度墜毀了。
The first airplane flew in 1903 for twelve seconds.
世上第一架飛機是在一九零三年起飛的，整個過程歷時十二秒。
Where is your twenty? I'll give you five bucks for it.
你的二十塊在哪裡? 我給你五塊錢找到它。
Take after meals, twice per day, two tablets each time.
飯後服用，一日兩次，一次兩粒。
The comparison between the two was to his disadvantage.
兩相比較，他那邊的形勢更不利一些。
I believe this type of medicine will help your illness.
我相信這種藥對你的病情有幫助。
My parents have gone to the airport to see my uncle off.
我父母去機場送我叔叔了。

entries.zh: 在下面,在下方；從屬地；在…下面
example: The cat is sleeping under the table.
貓正在桌子底下睡覺。
The examples in this dictionary are easy to understand.
這本字典的例句十分淺白易懂。

entries.zh: 相同的,一致的；不變的；使成一樣；使一律化；制服
example: The New York City police wear a dark blue uniform.
紐約警察穿深藍色制服。
It was not until I reached home that I missed my purse.
那是在我到家以後，我才不見了我的錢包。

entries.zh: 向上的；上行的；提高；增加；舉起；突然站起；向上；向...上；上升；走運
entries.pos: 形容詞、動詞、副詞、介系詞、名詞
example: We've been matched up with some strong teams this year.
我們今年和不少強隊交過手。
The Catholic Church doesn't condone the use of condoms.
天主教廷不同意避孕套的使用。
Due to the heavy rain, vegetable prices have risen.
多虧了這場大雨，蔬菜價格直線上升。

entries.zh: 很；非常；正是；恰好是；僅僅
example: My brother is very important. At least he thinks he is.
我弟弟非常重要。至少他認為他是。

entries.zh: 電視的；電視影像的；錄影的；錄影機；錄影帶
example: I'd like to marry a girl who likes to play video games.
我想和一個喜歡打電動的女孩結婚。
You should practice playing the violin every day.
你應該每天練習拉小提琴。
Due to global warming, cities could be completely submerged.
由於全球氣候變暖，城市可能被完全地淹沒。
The cinema gives discounts every Monday and Wednesday.
電影院每週一和每週三都有折扣。
In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
有些動物會在秋天為冬季儲藏食物。
Some Christians object to calling Christmas Xmas because Christ is left out.
Living in the grown-up world is yucky.
He invited us home to lunch on Sunday and cooked really yummy snails.
Her absence went unnoticed until the end of the meeting.
直到會議結束之前都沒人注意到她不在。
He was absent from school yesterday because he was ill.
他昨天沒來上學，因為他病了。
People can accept praise more easily than criticism.
讚揚比批評更容易讓人接受。
The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
警察調查事故的原因。
We must take into account the fact that he is young.
我們必須考慮到他很年輕。
The active volcano erupts at regular intervals.
活火山會定期爆發。
The movie called "Paranormal Activity" was not that much good.
那部叫“鬼影實錄”的電影並沒那麼好。
To date nobody knows the actual size of the cosmos.
宇宙的實際大小至今無人知道。
In addition, coincidences inevitably come in threes.
不但如此，巧合的事還會接二連三地發生。

entries.zh: 寫上收件人姓名地址；向...致詞；地址；演說
example: Please write down and give to me your personal address.
請把您的個人地址寫給我。
I admit that this may not be the best way of doing it.
我承認這可能不是最好的方法。

entries.zh: 成年的；成熟的；色情的；成年人
example: Two adult tickets and three children's tickets to London, please.
請給我兩張到倫敦的成人票，三張兒童票。

entries.zh: 推進；提升；貸(款)；前進；發展；預付
example: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
地面高低不平，給部隊前進帶來了困難。
Not knowing what to do, I asked the teacher for advice.
因為不知道做什麼，所以我向老師尋求建議。

entries.zh: 事件；風流韻事；喜慶活動
example: Our love affair was as short-lived as a soap bubble.
我們的愛情就像肥皂泡一樣脆弱。
Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
其他人的期望會影響我們的行為。
Tom didn't know what he'd done was against the rules.
湯姆不知道他的所作所為違反了規則。
If you can't come, you should let me know ahead of time.
如果你不能來，你該讓我提前知道。

entries.zh: 有助於；幫助；助手；助聽器
example: Perhaps you will seek his aid.
你也許要尋求他的幫助。
Their common aim was to make the project successful.
這些人共同的目標是把這個專案做成功。
China has the means to destroy your aircraft carriers.
中國有能力摧毀你們的航空母艦。

entries.zh: 向...報警；使驚慌不安；警鈴；警報；驚慌
example: You've got to set the alarm clock before you go to bed.
在你上床睡覺之前，你必須把鬧鐘設定好。
He sat quietly at his desk, flipping through the yellowed photo album.
他靜靜地坐在書桌前，翻閱著那本泛黃的相簿。
These twin brothers are as alike as two peas in a pod.
這兩個雙胞胎兄弟長得一模一樣。
If she was still alive, she would be able to help me.
如果她還活著的話，現在能幫我。

entries.zh: 單獨的；孤單的；單獨地；獨自地
example: We think that it is dangerous to climb mountains alone.
我們覺得你獨自登山非常危險。
I'd like Tom to read what's written on that paper aloud.
請湯姆大聲朗讀紙上的內容。
He doesn't altogether trust me.
他並不完全信任我。
She's not among the regular employees of this company.
她不是這間公司正式的職員。
We will pay you according to the amount of work you do.
我們會按照你的工作量付錢給你。
The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
神話讓我們能透悉古文明。
Jim was able to hold back his anger and avoid a fight.
Jim抑制住了怒火，避免了一場鬥爭。
An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
90度的角叫直角。
She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
她鍛鍊時扭傷了腳踝。
Is there anyplace around here where I can rent a motorcycle?
I don't think this rain will let up anytime soon.
我看這雨還會下一陣子。
I don't have a CD player, but I bought the CD anyway.
我沒有 CD 播放機，但還是把唱片買下來了。
Do you know if there's a steam room anywhere around here?
你知道這附近哪裡有汗蒸房嗎？
Ziri saw a creature that looked like an ape with webbed fingers.
John is brave in appearance, but is in reality a coward.
約翰看起來很勇敢，但其實是個膽小鬼。
After skiing, I find that I have a voracious appetite.
滑完雪後，我發現我食慾大增。
If you want this job, you must apply for it by tomorrow.
如果你想要這份工作的話，就一定要在明天之前申請。
I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
感謝你幫我解釋明白。

entries.zh: 接近,靠近；靠近；方法,門徑
example: We should approach this problem from different angles.
我們應該用各種不同的角度看待此問題
Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
湯姆和瑪麗無時無刻不在辯論。
An argument may be logically sound without being true.
不正確的命題聽起來可能符合邏輯。
We bought a comfortable new armchair.
我們買了張舒適的扶手椅。
I had been in the army for a month when the war ended.
戰爭結束的時候，我已經在軍隊裡待了一箇月。
I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
我會安排一下，叫個人去你家接你。
Flower arrangement is a part of Japanese culture.
花道是日本文化的一部分。
With the arrival of winter, leaves fall from the trees.
樹上的葉子隨著冬天的到來而掉落。
Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana.
光陰飛逝如箭; 果蠅喜歡香蕉。
The article begins with an account of the current situation.
文章開頭講了當前的形勢。
Making a living as a manga artist is almost impossible.
以漫畫家謀生幾乎不可能。
You cannot wake a person who is pretending to be asleep.
你無法叫醒一個裝睡的人。
They explored every avenue in an attempt to avoid war.
他們盡一切手段避免戰爭。
I haven't decided yet whether I will attend the party.
我還沒決定要不要參加派對。
The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
展覽大大地吸引了公眾的注意。

entries.zh: 開創,發起；著作,編寫；作者；作家
example: Euclid was the author of the first book on mathematics.
歐幾裡得是第一本數學著作的作者。

entries.zh: 可用的,可得到的,有效的
example: There are many jobs available in the computer industry.
計算機產業能夠提供相當多的就業崗位。

entries.zh: 平均的；算出...的平均數；使平衡；平均為；平均；平均數
example: How many times a minute does the average person blink?
人平均一分鐘眨幾次眼睛？
You'd better avoid discussion of religion and politics.
你最好別提到宗教和政治這些話題。
We need you to baby-sit.
We need a baby-sitter for Saturday evening.
我們星期六晚上需要一位臨時保母。

entries.zh: 把...放入背包；背負簡便行李旅行；背包
example: Inside my backpack there are many colored pens, red ones, blue ones, green ones, etc.
我的書包裡有很多彩色筆，紅的，藍的，綠的，等等。

entries.zh: 向後的；落後的；向後地；落後地
example: Social conditions are going backward rather than forward.
社會不是在進步，而是在退步。
They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.
他們往前走而我一直都在往後退。
I used to play badminton a lot, but I don’t play anymore.
我以前常去打羽毛球，但現在不打了。
There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
廚房有烤箱，可以用來烤麵包。
I'm going to the bakery now. Do you want anything?
我現在要去麵包店了。你想要什麼嗎？
The balance of public opinion remains in his favor.
公眾意見的平衡仍是他的關切。
Why don't you go out on the balcony and get some sun?
去陽臺上曬曬太陽怎麼樣？

entries.zh: 像氣球般鼓起(或膨脹)；乘氣球上升；激增；汽球
example: The balloon was caught in the tree.
這顆氣球被樹絆住了。

entries.zh: 閂住；阻攔；禁止；棒,條；酒吧
example: Did you have any romantic encounter at the bar last night?
昨天去酒吧有豔遇嗎？
We'll have a barbecue at the beach.
我們要在海邊烤肉。
A barber is a man who shaves and cuts men's hair.
理髮師是為男人刮鬍子和剪頭髮的人。
A dog will bark at strangers.
狗會對陌生人叫。
His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
他的薪水包括基本工資和提成。
The basic components of Chinese characters are called "radicals".
漢字的基本單位稱作「部首」。
Vowelizing letters is one of the basics of writing in the Arabic language.
為字母新增母音是阿拉伯語書寫的基礎之一。
We conduct safety inspections here on a regular basis.
我們定期在這裡施行安全檢查。
This river is dangerous to bathe in.
在這河裡游泳危險。
Many soldiers suffered terrible wounds in the battle.
很多士兵在這場戰役中嚴重受傷。
We ate at the BBQ party like there was no tomorrow.
This is the first time I've ever grown a beard.
這是我第一次長鬍子。

entries.zh: 擊敗；敲擊；敲打；敲擊聲；心跳聲；滴答聲；拍子
example: As far as English is concerned, nobody can beat me.
在英語能力方面，沒有人能比我好。
The beauty of the scene was beyond description.
那裡的景色美得無法以筆墨形容。
I suspect that they water down the beer in that pub.
我懷疑那家酒館的啤酒兌水了。
I beg your pardon; I didn't quite catch your name.
能再說一次嗎？我沒聽清楚你的名字。
Tom's a beginner, but he catches on fast.
湯姆是個初學者，但他趕上得很快。
Many people cannot understand the way hackers behave.
很多人無法理解駭客們的行為。
Being late is always better than not showing up at all.
遲到總比不到好。
It's my belief that knowledge is power.
我相信，知識就是力量。
Is it believable?
可信嗎？
Einstein predicted that the Sun's gravity would bend light.
愛因斯坦預測太陽的引力會彎曲光線。

entries.zh: 較佳的；更好的；更適當的；改善；提高；超過；變得較好；更好地；更適當地；(人或事物)較優者,較好者
example: Tom is better at science than anyone else in his class.
湯姆的科學成績比班上的任何一個人都要好。

entries.zh: 在更遠處；越出；晚於；在...那一邊
example: Its modernization was far beyond my expectations.
它現代化的程度遠遠超乎我的預料。
Bill doesn't like the fact that his father smokes a lot.
比爾不喜歡他父親抽很多煙的這個事實。
The Milky Way consists of about a hundred billion stars.
銀河系大約由一千億顆恆星組成。
She gave birth to her first child at twenty years old.
她在二十歲的時候生下第一個孩子。
The biscuit was coated with a wafer-thin layer of chocolate.

entries.zh: 小片,；少量,一點點；片刻；位元
example: You're right. The noodle broth here is a bit expensive.
您說得對。這裡的麵湯比較貴。
Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
比較一下你寫的句子和黑板上的句子。
None of us thought he was to blame for the accident.
我們都不認為他是事故的罪魁禍首。

entries.zh: 空白的；空的,無內容的；茫然的；空白
example: My mind was blank.
我的腦一片空白。
Please take the pillow and blanket and give them to me.
請把枕頭和毯子拿給我。
A knife covered in blood was recovered at the crime scene.
犯罪現場發現了一把沾滿鮮血的刀。

entries.zh: 上車；上船；木板；膳食；車上；船上；董事會
example: When children play Go, they use a 5-by-5 or 7-by-7 board.
孩子們下圍棋，會使用5x5或者7x7的棋盤。

entries.zh: (水等)沸騰；開；滾；沸騰；煮沸；翻滾
example: Boil chestnuts for at least 15 minutes.
栗子至少要煮15分鐘。
An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
冰冷的疾風吹到我骨子裡去了。
Look at him! He's bony, he can barely pick up a bottle of water.
There is a bookstore in front of the department store.
百貨商店前有個書店。
Canada and Mexico both share a border with the USA.
加拿大和墨西哥跟美國分享一個國境。

entries.zh: 煩擾；煩惱,麻煩；使人煩惱的人(或事物)
example: Don't bother your parents with such a pointless thing.
別為了這樣的小事麻煩你父母。
Idiot... You got water in your brain or something?

I doubt if Mary would do that if she were in your shoes.
我懷疑如果瑪麗處在你的位置上是否還會那樣做。
There is a white dove on the roof.
屋頂上有隻白鴿。
If you do not have this program, you can download it now.
假如你沒有這個程式，你現在就可以去下載。
I went downstairs and turned off the light.
我下樓把燈關了。
The dragon is one of the cultural emblems of China.
龍是中國的文化圖騰。
The new TV drama is quite interesting.
這部新電視劇挺有意思的。
There is a pair of worn red stockings in the drawer.
抽屜裡有一雙穿過的紅色絲襪。

entries.zh: 描繪,素描；製圖；抽籤；提款
example: "Drawing dragons and dotting in the eyes" is a fable.
畫龍點睛是一則寓言故事。

entries.zh: 使服麻醉藥；使服毒品；藥品；毒品
example: Tom has a long history of drug abuse.
湯姆有長期濫用藥物的歷史。
Mary dried her hair with a hair dryer.
瑪莉用吹風機吹乾頭髮。

entries.zh: 應支付的；欠款的；(置於方位詞前)正；應得之物；應得權益；應付款；稅金
example: Due to bad weather, the plane arrived three hours late.
由於天氣不好，飛機遲到了3小時。

entries.zh: 晦暗的；無光澤的；弄鈍；使不活躍；減少；減輕
example: Were it not for music, the world would be a dull place.
如果沒有了音樂，這個世界就會變得十分沉悶。
There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
暴動開始時只有一位監獄長值班。
As the lion is king of beasts, so is the eagle king of birds.
如果獅子是百獸之王的話，鷹就是百鳥之王了。
Blondes earn 7% more than women with any other hair color.
金髮女郎比其他顏色頭髮的女人多賺7％。
Ziri got down on his knees to help Rima search for her earring.
Just as he was going out, there was a great earthquake.
就在他要出門的時候，發生了強震。

entries.zh: 減輕；容易；不費力；舒適；悠閒,放鬆,緩和
example: When I speak Chinese, I start to feel at ease.
我說中文的時候，開始感到自在了。
Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
東歐的酒精消耗量比西歐高。

entries.zh: 使鋒利；使漸進；邊緣；優勢
example: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
側邊欄顯示在網站標誌下方的頁面邊緣。
Which is more complete, the first edition or the second?
第一還是第二的版本比較齊全？
Parents are responsible for their children's education.
父母承擔教育子女的責任。
Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
環境汙染可以對一個區域的生態造成極大的影響。
This poison is very effective in getting rid of roaches.
這毒藥用來治蟑螂很有效。
With just a little more effort, he would have succeeded.
如果他再努力一點，就可能已經成功了。
My elder brother finished his homework very quickly.
我哥哥很快就把功課做完了。
My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
我最喜歡的樂器是電吉他。
Sharks are sensitive to electrical impulses as well as sound.
鯊魚對電子訊號和噪音很敏感。
Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
任何情緒，只要它是真誠的，就說明它是發自內心的自然流露。
I want to emphasize this point in particular.
我想特別強調這一點。
His age didn't enter into our decision not to employ him.
我們決定不錄用他時，並沒有考慮他的年齡問題。
She's not a full-time employee of this company.
她不是這間公司正式的職員。
The job applicant did not meet the expectations of the employer.
Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
請把印表機裡面的空的墨粉鼓換掉。
When I'm sad, my friends encourage me.
我傷心的時候，我的朋友會鼓勵我。
Tom needs encouragement.
湯姆需要鼓勵。
I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
我不想把結局提前透露給你。
Our biggest enemy may not be someone else, but ourselves.
我們最大的敵人不是別人，可能是自己。
The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
細胞具有將食物轉化為能量的能力。
Reluctantly, he started the engine and drove off.
他不情願地啟動引擎開車走了。
No hobby is as cheap as reading, nor provides such long lasting enjoyment.
沒有任何娛樂像閱讀這般廉價，也沒有任何愉悅像閱讀這般持久。
Don't generalize individual behavior to an entire group.
不要把個人行為上升到集體。
I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!
我聽說你透過了入學考試。恭喜你了！
We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
我們應該盡力不要汙染環境。

entries.zh: 環境的；有關環境(保護)的
example: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
人類適應環境變化的能力很強。

entries.zh: 相等的；平等的；等於；相等的事物；相等的數量
example: God created all men equal but men think it differently.
神平等造人而人心各異。
They went to Edinburgh to escape from the summer heat.
他們去了愛丁堡避暑。
You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
你尤其不該空腹喝酒。
This essay is progressing a little bit slowly.
論文的進度有點慢。
Dumplings are essential at the New Year's Eve dinner table.
餃子是年夜飯桌上必不可少的。
What would you do in the event of a zombie apocalypse?
在殭屍啟示錄的事件中你會怎麼做？
As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
只要好人袖手旁觀，惡人就會得勝。
I do not understand the exact meaning of this sentence.
我不是很清楚這個句子的意思。
The friend who I thought would pass the exam failed it.
那個我認為會透過考試的朋友失敗了。
You should go get a physical examination from a doctor.
您應該讓醫生給您檢查身體。
It's hard for people to examine and correct their own flaws.
人們難以審視和糾正自身的問題。
Every day brings new questions and answers that excite his curious mind greatly.
Hearing that a transfer student was coming, the class buzzed with excitement.
聽說要來一個轉校生之後，全班都亂哄哄地活躍起來。
There is no excuse to help get you out of the meeting.
你沒有任何藉口缺席這次會議。
Industry as we know it today didn't exist in those days.
我們今天所認識的工業在那個時代不存在。
Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?
你相信有幽靈嗎？
If there's an emergency, you must run out of the house through this exit.
有緊急情況時，必須透過這個出口跑出房子。
John finished the work at the expense of his health.
約翰犧牲自己的健康，完成工作。

entries.zh: 熟練的,老練的；專家的；專家；能手
example: It is for certain, he is the expert in this field.
他是這方面的專家，這是肯定的。

entries.zh: 快遞的,快運的；明確的；表示；用快遞；由直達快車；特意地；快車；快遞；快運
example: How about we use "express mail" so it arrives tomorrow.
要不寄“特快郵件”明天就可以到。
The English expression "Never mind!" has 444 translations on Tatoeba.
Tatoeba上的英語語句“Never mind!”已經有444條翻譯了。

entries.zh: 額外的；額外地；另外；特別地,非常地；附加的人物或錢；號外
example: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
我太太兼職的工作賺進了一些額外的錢。
Ziri raised an eyebrow and grinned sarcastically.
When applying to American universities, your TOEFL score is only one factor.
當您登記美國大學時，您考TOEFL獲得的分數只是所選因素的其中一個。

把你的失敗歸咎於你的父母是不對的。

entries.zh: 公平的；美好的；公平地,公正地；正面地；商品展覽會
example: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
把你的失敗歸咎於你的父母是不對的。
The truth is that nothing is totally true or false.
真相是沒有甚麼完全正確或錯誤。

entries.zh: 把...塑造成；流行式樣；時尚
example: She was able to cook herself dinner, after a fashion.
她勉強能自己煮晚餐吃。
I would rather kill myself than reconcile myself to my fate.
與其向命運妥協，我寧可自殺。

entries.zh: 挑...的毛病；產生斷層；過錯
example: I'm really sorry, it's all my fault - I didn't notice you.
真對不起，剛才都怪我，沒注意到您。

entries.zh: 支持,擁護；有利於；偏愛；偏袒
example: The balance of public opinion remains in his favor.
公眾意見的平衡仍是他的關切。

entries.zh: 最喜愛的；特別喜愛的人(或物)
example: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
湯姆捐一半他的薪水給他最喜歡的慈善機構。
She is on a diet for fear that she will put on weight.
她因為擔心發胖而節食。
It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
這不是一個漏洞，而是一個沒有寫進文件的特性。
How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?
這間游泳學校每個月的學費是多少？
After a couple of drinks, the guy was feeling no pain.
喝了幾杯酒後，這個傢伙就感覺不痛了。
He's your senior fellow apprentice.
他是你的師兄。
A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
我的一個女性朋友喜歡跟我一起去同志酒吧。
You've got a bit of a fever today, don't you?
你今天有點發燒，是吧？
Let's go to the field and fly kites, what do you say?
咱們到田園去放風箏怎麼樣？

entries.zh: 估計；描繪；外形；數字；圖表；(溜冰等)花式
example: Two men are trying to figure out what's wrong with the car.
兩個男人在檢查汽車出了什麼故障。

entries.zh: 最終的；決賽；期末考；(當日報紙的)末版
example: The game ended in a draw, and the final score was 2-2.
比賽以平局結束，最後比分是二比二。
Tom wasn't rescued by a fireman. He was rescued by a policeman.
The firewoman carried the child out of the burning house.
這位女消防員把孩子抱出失火的房子。

entries.zh: 牢固的；使穩固；使牢固；變堅實；穩固地；牢固地
example: Though I may be in the jaws of death, I am as a firm as a rock.
我雖然在虎口裡，卻是安如泰山。
The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.
漁民用他的網捕到了一隻紫色的水母。

entries.zh: 適合的；恰當的；相稱的；能勝任的；合身；適合；適合；合身
example: Sami was the only one who could fit into the costume.
薩米是唯一一個能穿上這件衣服的人。

entries.zh: 修理；困境；窘境；賄賂；定位
example: We shall fix all bugs today before leaving the office.
我們應該在今天下班前解決所有bug。

entries.zh: 打旗號表示；衰退,低落；旗子
example: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.
美國國旗的顏色是紅白藍。

entries.zh: 平的；使變平；降半音；平直地,仰臥地；恰恰,正好；斷然地；平坦部分
example: I have to push my bike because one of the tyres is flat.
我得推我的腳踏車，因為有個輪胎漏氣了。

我們在飛機起飛前三個小時就到達了機場。
Though tears may flow down your face, I won't look back.
任憑眼淚在你臉上滑過，我頭也不回。

我們全都染上了流感，連老師也不例外。
Stop saying trifles! Focus on the main point.
廢話少說，說重點。

entries.zh: 以霧籠罩；使困惑；使模糊；霧
example: London, where I live, used to be famous for its fog.
我住的地方－倫敦，從前以霧聞名。
I heard a group of young women singing folk songs in the park.

entries.zh: 接著的,其次的；下面的；在...以後；一批追隨者；下列事物(或人員)

湯姆星期一來的，第二天返回了。

可惜，世界上的愚人總比聰明人要多。
Our football team defeated all the other teams in the city.
我們的足球隊打敗了市裡所有其他隊。

不要強迫自己做不喜歡的事情。

湯姆和瑪麗亞到樹林裡採集蘑菇去了。

「小說啊？我就討厭看小說。」天哪，請原諒她的褻瀆行為。

請你把這張表填一下，等我們的通知。
There's no need for you to prepare a formal speech.
您沒必要準備一個正式的演講。
Either one is fine, but the former is more concise.
兩者都可以，但是前者更簡潔。
He asked me my age, my name, my address, and so forth.
他問了我的年齡、姓名、地址等等。

entries.zh: 前面的；轉遞；向前地；前鋒
example: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
我期待聽到你在這件事上的想法 。
They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.
他們往前走而我一直都在往後退。
I found a good place to buy fruit a couple of days ago.
前幾天我發現了一個買水果的好地方。
There are two kinds of fox spirits: good fox and bad fox.
有兩種狐狸精神：好狐狸和壞狐狸。
War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
戰爭即和平，自由即奴役，無知即力量。
The ice-cream will melt, so I put it in the fridge.
冰淇淋會融化所以我把它放在冰箱裡。
I hope this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
希望這是美好友誼的開始。
Did you really order sweet potato fries to go with your veggie burger?
您真的點了地瓜片來搭配素食漢堡嗎？

這些雞蛋壞掉了，不能拿來煎。
Rats also have a function. They help to clean the pipes.
鼠類也有用處。它們能幫著清潔管道。
A few years ago, our room had little furniture in it.
幾年前，我們的房間裡沒有什麼傢俱。

entries.zh: 較遠的；另外的；更遠地；進一步地；促進；助長；而且；再者
example: Its modernisation went much further than I had expected.
它現代化的程度遠遠超乎我的預料。

entries.zh: 得到；增進；獲得；增加；獲利；收益
example: You gain more than you spend when you go to college.
上大學的時候，你得到的比付出的還多。

在我們的城市那，我們非常謹慎地分類收集垃圾。
The gardener planted a rose tree in the middle of the garden.
園丁在花園的中央種了一棵玫瑰樹。
I like garlic but, because of the smell, I rarely eat it.
雖然我喜歡大蒜，但因為很臭，所以很少吃。
The children gather into groups to play.
孩子們集結成群的在玩耍。
In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
一般來說，消費者喜歡數量勝於質量。
A gentle wind made ripples on the surface of the pond.
微風在湖面上掀起了一絲絲漣漪。
The man I saw yesterday was a complete gentleman.
我昨天見到的男人根本是紳士。
The newborn giraffe stumbled around on rickety legs.
新生的長頸鹿搖晃著腿跌跌撞撞地走。
Some furniture is put together with glue.
一些傢俱是用膠水黏在一起。
In the last minute, Marcello scored an equalizing goal.
在最後一分鐘，馬塞洛射進一球，將比賽打成平局。

羊屁股先生可沒告訴我還有搭檔。
As the saying goes: Speech is silver, silence is gold.
常言道：言語是銀，沉默是金。
Straight golden hair slides over her shoulder.
垂直的金髮滑過她的肩膀。
At Christmas, one eats roast goose, red cabbage, and wheat buns.
聖誕節時，人們會吃烤鵝、紅甘藍和小麥麵包。
To govern a country is not an easy job.
統治一個國家不是一件簡單的工作。
Learning is a gradual process.
學習是一個循序漸進的過程。
There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.
他說的話全不可信。
My wife gave birth prematurely to a 1,500-gram baby girl.
The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
一等獎是公主的香吻。
That isn't wine. It's grape juice.
這不是葡萄酒，是葡萄汁。
People, old and young, all came out to greet the guests.
無論老幼，人們都出來迎接貴客。
We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
進口數量的急速增長讓我們感到驚訝。
Be on your guard. He's not an easy one to fool.
要留神，他不容易受騙。
I brought a fresh guava for lunch.
我帶了一顆新鮮的芭樂當午餐的一部分。
I felt as if I were an uninvited guest.
我覺得自己像是不請自來似的。
This book is a good guide for beginners.
這本書對新手來說是一本很好的手冊。
Tom put the gun to his own head and pulled the trigger.
湯姆把槍頂到了自己頭上，扣動了扳機。
Hsin-yi got so much slimmer lately. Is it gym or heartbreak?
欣怡最近瘦好多喔，是去健身房還是失戀啊？
I got a glimpse of the wrestler as he hurriedly left the gymnasium.
Tom has gone to get a haircut, but he should be back soon.
湯姆去理髮了，但是他很快就會回來。
Do you know how far it is from the station to city hall?
你知道從火車站到市政府有多遠？
A hamburger and a cold drink cost 7 liras.
漢堡和冷飲要七里拉。
The handle came away from the door when I grasped it.
我握住門把，它就從門上掉了下來。
My father must have been handsome in his youth.
我爸爸年輕的時候一定很英俊。
I felt so sleepy that I could hardly keep my eyes open.
我感覺困得幾乎不能睜開我的眼睛了。
In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
起初，神創造了天地。
We called him a "hero", but he betrayed us.
我們把他稱為“英雄”，但是他卻背叛了我們。
The heroine of this story is a little girl.
這個故事的女主角是一個小女孩。

我知道有人認識我的可能性微乎其微。
Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
今天早上高速公路上的交通狀況正常。
We should cancel the hike.
我們應該取消這次遠足。
He got a hip ultrasound.
他做了髖部超音波檢查。
The hippo is Africa's most deadly animal.
The Council slaves whipped him with their hippopotamus hide whips.
A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
一座歷史地標已經修復並將重新開放。

entries.zh: 鑿洞於,穿孔於；進入洞中；洞
example: I'm so embarrassed I could dig a hole and crawl into it.
我窘得想找個洞鑽進去。

entries.zh: 單足跳；單足跳；跳躍；麻藥(尤指鴉片)
example: Let me know beforehand instead of catching me on the hop at the last minute.
事先打個招呼，別叫我臨時抓瞎。

entries.zh: 主人；主辦,主持；以主人身分招待
example: The party host had a Portuguese accent.
派對主席說話時有葡萄牙腔
He married an air hostess.
他娶了一個空姐。
Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.
從天上看下來，這條河像一條巨蛇。
Seen from a distance, the stone looks like a human face.
從遠看得話，這個石頭看起來像人的臉。

entries.zh: 謙恭的；微賤的；使謙卑；使威信掃地
example: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
金窩銀窩不如自己的狗窩。

你見過雪豹在山上狩獵嗎？
The hunter chases the rabbit in the fields.
獵人在田野追兔子
